mapper.select: -- 步骤1：查询所有已装箱发货单对应的发货任务记录，统计每个待发明细的累计发货量（不关注员工身份信息） WITH shipped AS ( SELECT atd.awaiting_details_code, SUM(COALESCE(atd.this_count, 0)) AS shipped_total FROM ${awaitingTaskDetailsTable} atd INNER JOIN ${invoiceOrderTable} io ON io.primary_key = atd.invoice_order WHERE atd.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} AND atd.delete_flag = false AND io.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} AND io.delete_flag = false AND io.packaged = true GROUP BY atd.awaiting_details_code ) -- 步骤2：关联待发明细表，按产品分组统计总累计发货量和总需发货�? SELECT ad.product_code AS productCode, ad.product_name AS productName, COALESCE(SUM(sh.shipped_total), 0) AS shippedTotal, SUM(COALESCE(ad.product_quantity, 0)) AS quantityTotal FROM ${awaitingDetailsTable} ad LEFT JOIN shipped sh ON sh.awaiting_details_code = ad.primary_key WHERE ad.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} AND ad.delete_flag = 'f' AND ad.product_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ad.product_code, ad.product_name
